overclaims: Meta's April 18 announcement documented free access, question answering, image generation, and integration across Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Messenger [e1].
checks.note: The proposition leaves out 'free' and 'ask questions and generate images', so it commits the speaker to less than the statement. In e1, 'free' does not appear, and Imagine was a US beta on WhatsApp and the web only, so image generation across all four apps is unsupported. The cited excerpts are cut down until they mislead: e1 drops 'available in search', e2 drops 'through the app settings on any of the apps', and e3's 'Group administrators' says nothing. The axis, horizon and outcome match the agreed reviews.
